ambiguities.text: The specification does not define behavior for eth_getBlockByNumber which also returns block data
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the same baseFee inclusion rules apply to eth_getBlockByNumber as they do to eth_getBlockByHash. This needs verification against actual client implementations.

ambiguities.text: The term 'Quantity format' is used without explicit definition in this EIP
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume Quantity format refers to the standard Ethereum JSON-RPC encoding: hexadecimal string with '0x' prefix, no leading zeros except for zero value itself.

implicit_assumptions.description: The client has accurate knowledge of which block number the EIP-1559 fork activated at
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Clients may incorrectly include or omit baseFee field for blocks near the fork boundary, causing interoperability issues

implicit_assumptions.description: The baseFee value stored in the block header is authentic and has not been tampered with
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Clients could receive incorrect baseFee information leading to improper gas price calculations
